notes.title: Development update - Guerrilla Collective
notes.notes:
Continuing on my plan to do more regular updates here is this weeks and it’s an exciting one. 
I’ve been busy working on my levels, tweaking old ones and optimizing Super Adventure Hand further.

The exciting part is that late on Wednesday / Thursday (depending on where you are) I will be releasing a new updated demo. This will have lots of new tweaks, fixes, squashed bugs and a brand new level to play! 
There is also one other addition but I won’t spoil the surprise, you’ll just have to check it out and let me know what you think!

Super Adventure Hand will also make an appearance at the Guerrilla Collective so tune into the stream to check it out on Wednesday!

notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
I’m going to try and do more regular updates on things I’ve been working on so here goes!
This last week I spent a large chunk of time creating some new levels. I managed to make 5 more which have all come together nicely. They offer various different challenges and I promise I’ve not been too devious!

To tease you a little I can reveal that in these levels there is more fire, pipes, keys (of course) some little ones and plenty of opportunities to use your brains (well hand brains). I’ve also found an opportunity to reuse some other aspects of some previous levels in new and interesting ways.
There is some exciting stuff coming which I can’t say much about yet but be prepared to see some new things in early June!
